BJP Appoints Election In-Charges for Upcoming State Polls

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has appointed election in-charges for upcoming Assembly elections in Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Gujarat. Vinod Tawde will oversee Uttar Pradesh, while Satish Poonia and Tarun Chug will lead the efforts in Punjab and Gujarat, respectively. This organizational reshuffling, under the leadership of Nitin Nabin, introduces new faces and poll specialists to the party's national team. Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated the new office bearers, highlighting their energy and grassroots connection.
